problem: User-facing product still mixes Odds Gods and Olympus.
recommendation: Rename public UI to Odds Gods; keep Olympus only where infra/internal rename risk is high.
evidence: App title says `Olympus - Odds Gods`; header renders `ODDS GODS` plus `OLYMPUS`; multiple pages say `Welcome to Olympus`.
notes: User-facing brand strings now render Odds Gods; internal Olympus identifiers stay unchanged.

problem: Initial projection hydration can show fake-looking even lines and zero projections.
recommendation: Mask provisional pricing behind a loading/reduced-confidence state until projections are ready.
evidence: Local first render showed 50/50, 100.0 vs 100.0, and player rows at 0.0.
notes: Connected Matchup gates pricing UI until pricing.available is true.

problem: Top nav and action cluster are too crowded for a new user.
recommendation: Reduce primary nav to Matchup, League, Trade, Board, More; move Projections/admin/help out of primary nav.
evidence: Header currently shows Matchup, Season, Trade, My Board, Projections, League, More, How this works, Week, Synced, PPR, %, account.
notes: Primary nav is now Matchup, League, Trade, Board, More; Season is merged under League.

problem: Connected mobile has seven bottom tabs.
recommendation: Reduce mobile bottom nav to Matchup, League, Trade, Board, More; move Season under League and Projections under More/admin.
evidence: BottomTabBar currently renders Matchup, Season, Trade, My Board, Projections, League, More for connected redraft leagues.
notes: Bottom nav is now Matchup, League, Trade, Board, More; Season is merged under League.

problem: `Who do I start?` appears as both instruction and button even though rows are tappable.
recommendation: Remove the redundant button; use `Tap two players to compare` as lightweight helper copy if needed.
evidence: Matchup lineup renders `Tap any player: who do I start?` plus a `Who do I start?` button.
notes: Standalone lineup compare button removed; lineup hint now reads Tap two players to compare.

problem: Row-level `Start K. Williams` text feels repetitive and inelegant.
recommendation: Replace with compact `Swap` or `+X%` chip; reveal fuller text in verdict/tooltip.
evidence: Starter rows render `Best swap: K. Williams` plus separate `Start K. Williams` buttons.
notes: Starter rows now show one compact positive-delta chip that opens the existing verdict sheet; row-tap compare remains unchanged.

problem: Swap actions sound verbose or corny.
recommendation: Rename `Preview the swap` to `Preview`; rename `Make it official in Sleeper` to `Open Sleeper`.
evidence: Current Biggest Edge actions include `Preview the swap` and `Make it official in Sleeper`.
notes: Biggest Edge and verdict swap actions now use Preview/Open platform copy.

problem: A stale personalized model can remain active without the user remembering.
recommendation: Show last edited time and prompt after 14 days: continue saved board, use baseline, or review changes.
evidence: User noted returning after 3 weeks and seeing `Your model`; current UI says `Your model · on Franco ...`.
notes: Static Baseline/Active/Stale chip and last-edited metadata landed; re-entry prompt is blocked because the model overlay currently only has destructive reset-to-Franco, not a non-destructive active-pricing-mode switch.

problem: Board page uses long self-explanatory prose that feels generated.
recommendation: Replace paragraph with model status metadata: active board, baseline, last edited, pricing impact.
evidence: Current copy begins `This is your board to edit, not a printout...`.
notes: Long prose replaced with compact pricing/baseline/last-edited status metadata.

problem: Season and League overlap as league-market concepts.
recommendation: Merge Season into League subviews: This week, Futures, Schedule, Settings.
evidence: Season shows user futures/schedule; League shows league futures/week matchups/settings.
notes: League now owns URL-backed subviews for This week, Futures, Schedule, and Settings; /season redirects to /league?view=futures.

problem: Projections is an operator/admin tool but sits in primary fantasy-user nav.
recommendation: Move Projections to More or admin-only entry.
evidence: Projections page shows raw stat table, agreement editor, password edit flow.
notes: Projections removed from primary nav and added to More.

problem: Trade opens into a dense builder with advanced controls before first value.
recommendation: Start with simple choices: Price a trade, Find a deal, Find targets; move scouting controls secondary.
evidence: Trade page currently opens with full roster pickers, manager select, negotiator/appetite/fandom controls.

problem: More explains the app's IA instead of simply listing destinations.
recommendation: Remove meta-copy and group destinations by Account, League, Tools, Admin.
evidence: Current copy says `Matchup, season, trade, and league stay in the main tab bar...`.
notes: More is grouped destinations with Projections and How this works reachable.

problem: First connected Matchup view can be interrupted by a modal that explains the product.
recommendation: Prefer inline first-run hints and move the longer explanation behind Help/More.
evidence: WelcomeCard auto-opens on in-season Matchup until dismissed and contains three explanatory sections.
notes: App shell no longer auto-opens WelcomeCard on Matchup; More still owns the How this works entry.

problem: Odds are still mostly snapshot numbers.
recommendation: Add line history, movement reasons, and since-last-visit deltas.
evidence: Existing product audit and local render show static current prices with limited movement narrative.

problem: The product does not yet explain luck vs decision quality after results.
recommendation: Add post-week report: expected win chance, key decisions, variance read.
evidence: Competitive gap; aligns with Odds Gods as an honest internal book.
